name: Murarz
summary: Murarz is a fast-paced 2D arcade game, where players catch and fight off waves of enemies with unique abilities, supported by a dog companion that can be directed toward specific targets. The game features unlockable skills, an in-game economy, experience and progression systems, quests, achievements, and an Enemy Book documenting opponents. Players can customize their character and dog with cosmetic items, compete with friends through leaderboards, and take part in versus and co-op multiplayer battles.
